description: Turn real-time abandoned-checkout recovery on or off for this brand's Shopify store. Once on, Shopify tells Hermoso of every checkout as it happens; a checkout idle for delayMinutes (default 60) with no order fires ONE recovery. action "sequence" saves the buyer as a contact and enrols them in `sequence` (an id from list_email_sequences; steps may be email, sms, whatsapp, instagram or facebook), with the cart as merge fields {{cart_url}}, {{cart_items}}, {{cart_total}}, {{cart_item_count}}, {{greeting_name}} (the first name, or "there" when Shopify has none; {{first_name}} skips a nameless buyer), and {{discount_code}} / {{discount_url}} when discountCode is set. "alert" sends the event shopify.checkout_abandoned to the brand's Slack, Discord or webhook (set_alert_events group carts) for your own agent to act on; "both" does both. An order for the checkout (or by the same buyer) cancels a pending recovery and stops the sequence. consent "marketing" (default) uses an email or phone only when the buyer accepted marketing on it in Shopify; "any" uses whatever the checkout carries. A sequence with email steps needs listConfirmed:true. Read back from Shopify. Free.

attributionDays.description: 1-30, default 7: an order by the same buyer this long after a recovery counts as recovered

delayMinutes.description: how long a checkout sits idle before the recovery fires: 1 to 10080, default 60

discountCode.description: the store's discount code to offer ({{discount_code}}, {{discount_url}}); "" removes it

enabled.description: true turns recovery on, false off

listConfirmed.description: true confirms the people reached are the store's own shoppers (needed for a sequence with email steps)

minTotal.description: no recovery for a cart below this total (0 = every cart)

sequence.description: the sequence id to enrol buyers in (list_email_sequences)

name: set_shopify_cart_recovery
title: Set up abandoned-checkout recovery
